technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Intensive integrated production with cold-air drying in the barn.

# Included processes
The inventories include the cultivation of hay on a permanent meadow. Included steps are fertilisation (mineral fertiliser and liquid manure), weed control (Asulam against Rumex), harvest, transport to the farm, drying with cold air in the barn and the storage in the barn during 12 months.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from statistics, fertilising recommendations, documents from extension services and expert knowledge.
